Anneals the learning rate along a cosine to eta_min over T_max epochs.

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR: lr = eta_min + (learning_rate - eta_min) x (1 + cos(pi x epoch / T_max)) / 2, stepped after each completed epoch.

## Usage

```text
lr = eta_min + (learning_rate - eta_min) * (1 + cos(pi * epoch / T_max)) / 2, set after each completed epoch (torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR).
```

## Tips

- Set T_max to the run's epochs to end at eta_min.
- Past T_max the cosine rises again, as in PyTorch.
